description: The data examples/multi-user-timelines.html passes to FrameTrail.init(). Written by tests/extract-examples.mjs; change the page, not this file.

meta.name: Multi-User Timeline Demo
meta.description: Big Buck Bunny annotated by 10 users with a Timelines ContentView
meta.creator: Demo

body.value: The Blender Foundation logo and title sequence set the tone for the short film.
body.frametrail:name: Title card

frametrail:attributes.text: The Blender Foundation logo and title sequence set the tone for the short film.

body.value: Wide aerial shot establishes the lush pastoral landscape — classic animated film opening.
body.frametrail:name: Establishing shot

frametrail:attributes.text: Wide aerial shot establishes the lush pastoral landscape — classic animated film opening.

body.value: Big Buck Bunny is introduced enjoying a peaceful day. His gentle nature is established through body language.
body.frametrail:name: Character introduction

frametrail:attributes.text: Big Buck Bunny is introduced enjoying a peaceful day. His gentle nature is established through body language.

body.value: The butterfly appears — a symbol of innocence that will drive the plot forward.
body.frametrail:name: Inciting incident

frametrail:attributes.text: The butterfly appears — a symbol of innocence that will drive the plot forward.

body.value: Frank, the lead squirrel, is introduced. His aggressive posture contrasts with Bunny's gentleness.
body.frametrail:name: Antagonist reveal

frametrail:attributes.text: Frank, the lead squirrel, is introduced. His aggressive posture contrasts with Bunny's gentleness.

body.value: The squirrels' harassment of the butterfly pushes Bunny toward action.
body.frametrail:name: Conflict escalation

frametrail:attributes.text: The squirrels' harassment of the butterfly pushes Bunny toward action.

body.value: Bunny's expression shifts from sadness to determination — the emotional core of the film.
body.frametrail:name: Emotional turning point

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny's expression shifts from sadness to determination — the emotional core of the film.

body.value: Bunny gathers materials for his traps. The pacing accelerates, building anticipation.
body.frametrail:name: Planning montage

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny gathers materials for his traps. The pacing accelerates, building anticipation.

body.value: The first trap is sprung. Physical comedy takes center stage.
body.frametrail:name: Revenge sequence begins

frametrail:attributes.text: The first trap is sprung. Physical comedy takes center stage.

body.value: Each squirrel meets their comedic fate. Justice is served with slapstick flair.
body.frametrail:name: Climactic resolution

frametrail:attributes.text: Each squirrel meets their comedic fate. Justice is served with slapstick flair.

body.value: Impressive subsurface scattering on the grass blades — a major step up from Elephant's Dream.
body.frametrail:name: Rendering quality

frametrail:attributes.text: Impressive subsurface scattering on the grass blades — a major step up from Elephant's Dream.

body.value: Smooth crane shot descending into the meadow. The depth of field is beautifully handled.
body.frametrail:name: Camera movement

frametrail:attributes.text: Smooth crane shot descending into the meadow. The depth of field is beautifully handled.

body.value: Bunny's fur rendering uses strand-based simulation — groundbreaking for open-source at the time.
body.frametrail:name: Fur simulation

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny's fur rendering uses strand-based simulation — groundbreaking for open-source at the time.

body.value: The warm, diffused sunlight creates a fairy-tale atmosphere. Volumetric light rays through the trees.
body.frametrail:name: Lighting design

frametrail:attributes.text: The warm, diffused sunlight creates a fairy-tale atmosphere. Volumetric light rays through the trees.

body.value: Dust motes and floating seeds add life to the scene. Subtle but effective environmental storytelling.
body.frametrail:name: Particle effects

frametrail:attributes.text: Dust motes and floating seeds add life to the scene. Subtle but effective environmental storytelling.

body.value: Notice the shift to cooler tones during the conflict — the color palette mirrors the emotional arc.
body.frametrail:name: Color grading

frametrail:attributes.text: Notice the shift to cooler tones during the conflict — the color palette mirrors the emotional arc.

body.value: The trap mechanisms use rigid body physics. Props react naturally to forces.
body.frametrail:name: Physics simulation

frametrail:attributes.text: The trap mechanisms use rigid body physics. Props react naturally to forces.

body.value: Excellent per-object motion blur on the fast-moving elements. Adds cinematic polish.
body.frametrail:name: Motion blur

frametrail:attributes.text: Excellent per-object motion blur on the fast-moving elements. Adds cinematic polish.

body.value: Multiple render passes are composited — separate diffuse, specular, and ambient occlusion.
body.frametrail:name: Compositing layers

frametrail:attributes.text: Multiple render passes are composited — separate diffuse, specular, and ambient occlusion.

body.value: Orchestral score sets a whimsical tone. Strings and woodwinds evoke a pastoral setting.
body.frametrail:name: Opening music

frametrail:attributes.text: Orchestral score sets a whimsical tone. Strings and woodwinds evoke a pastoral setting.

body.value: Layered bird calls, insect buzzing, and wind create a rich outdoor soundscape.
body.frametrail:name: Ambient sound

frametrail:attributes.text: Layered bird calls, insect buzzing, and wind create a rich outdoor soundscape.

body.value: Bunny's leitmotif — a gentle bassoon melody — plays during his introduction.
body.frametrail:name: Character theme

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny's leitmotif — a gentle bassoon melody — plays during his introduction.

body.value: The squirrels' theme uses staccato pizzicato strings — mischievous and playful.
body.frametrail:name: Comedic timing

frametrail:attributes.text: The squirrels' theme uses staccato pizzicato strings — mischievous and playful.

body.value: The butterfly wing flutter is a pitch-shifted recording of paper. Creative foley work.
body.frametrail:name: Sound effects

frametrail:attributes.text: The butterfly wing flutter is a pitch-shifted recording of paper. Creative foley work.

body.value: The music drops to a minor key here, reflecting Bunny's sadness. Cello takes the lead.
body.frametrail:name: Emotional underscore

frametrail:attributes.text: The music drops to a minor key here, reflecting Bunny's sadness. Cello takes the lead.

body.value: Percussion enters — tympani rolls and snare hits build anticipation for the revenge sequence.
body.frametrail:name: Tension building

frametrail:attributes.text: Percussion enters — tympani rolls and snare hits build anticipation for the revenge sequence.

body.value: Classic cartoon sound effects: springs, bonks, and slide whistles. Homage to Looney Tunes.
body.frametrail:name: Slapstick sounds

frametrail:attributes.text: Classic cartoon sound effects: springs, bonks, and slide whistles. Homage to Looney Tunes.

body.value: Bunny's theme returns triumphant — now in a major key with full orchestration.
body.frametrail:name: Musical callback

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny's theme returns triumphant — now in a major key with full orchestration.

body.value: The music winds down to a gentle conclusion. Birdsong returns, bookending the soundtrack.
body.frametrail:name: Resolution

frametrail:attributes.text: The music winds down to a gentle conclusion. Birdsong returns, bookending the soundtrack.

body.value: Big Buck Bunny (2008) was the second open movie by the Blender Foundation, following Elephants Dream.
body.frametrail:name: About the project

frametrail:attributes.text: Big Buck Bunny (2008) was the second open movie by the Blender Foundation, following Elephants Dream.

body.value: Created in 6 months by a team of 7 artists at the Blender Institute in Amsterdam.
body.frametrail:name: Production facts

frametrail:attributes.text: Created in 6 months by a team of 7 artists at the Blender Institute in Amsterdam.

body.value: First Blender film to use strand-based hair/fur rendering and advanced particle systems.
body.frametrail:name: Technical milestone

frametrail:attributes.text: First Blender film to use strand-based hair/fur rendering and advanced particle systems.

body.value: Entire production pipeline is open source — Blender for 3D, Inkscape for concepts, GIMP for textures.
body.frametrail:name: Open source

frametrail:attributes.text: Entire production pipeline is open source — Blender for 3D, Inkscape for concepts, GIMP for textures.

body.value: Released under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Anyone can remix, share, and build upon it.
body.frametrail:name: License

frametrail:attributes.text: Released under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Anyone can remix, share, and build upon it.

body.value: Became a standard test video for streaming, codecs, and media players worldwide.
body.frametrail:name: Cultural impact

frametrail:attributes.text: Became a standard test video for streaming, codecs, and media players worldwide.

body.value: The film pushed Blender's particle and physics systems forward, benefiting all users.
body.frametrail:name: Blender evolution

frametrail:attributes.text: The film pushed Blender's particle and physics systems forward, benefiting all users.

body.value: Followed by Sintel (2010), Tears of Steel (2012), and many more open movies.
body.frametrail:name: Legacy

frametrail:attributes.text: Followed by Sintel (2010), Tears of Steel (2012), and many more open movies.

body.value: Gorgeous visuals right from the start. The quality rivals commercial studio work.
body.frametrail:name: First impressions

frametrail:attributes.text: Gorgeous visuals right from the start. The quality rivals commercial studio work.

body.value: The slow opening works well — gives the audience time to appreciate the world building.
body.frametrail:name: Pacing observation

frametrail:attributes.text: The slow opening works well — gives the audience time to appreciate the world building.

body.value: Bunny's expressive face is charming. The oversized eyes convey emotion effectively.
body.frametrail:name: Character design

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny's expressive face is charming. The oversized eyes convey emotion effectively.

body.value: The squirrels are delightfully obnoxious. Their small size vs Bunny creates good visual contrast.
body.frametrail:name: Villain design

frametrail:attributes.text: The squirrels are delightfully obnoxious. Their small size vs Bunny creates good visual contrast.

body.value: The butterfly scene genuinely tugs at your heartstrings. Simple but effective storytelling.
body.frametrail:name: Emotional engagement

frametrail:attributes.text: The butterfly scene genuinely tugs at your heartstrings. Simple but effective storytelling.

body.value: The mood shift from pastoral calm to revenge comedy is handled smoothly.
body.frametrail:name: Tone shift

frametrail:attributes.text: The mood shift from pastoral calm to revenge comedy is handled smoothly.

body.value: The physical comedy is universally appealing — no dialogue needed, works across languages.
body.frametrail:name: Comedy assessment

frametrail:attributes.text: The physical comedy is universally appealing — no dialogue needed, works across languages.

body.value: Each revenge gag escalates nicely. The timing is spot-on for animated comedy.
body.frametrail:name: Slapstick quality

frametrail:attributes.text: Each revenge gag escalates nicely. The timing is spot-on for animated comedy.

body.value: The payoff is earned. Bunny's victory feels justified after the setup.
body.frametrail:name: Satisfying conclusion

frametrail:attributes.text: The payoff is earned. Bunny's victory feels justified after the setup.

body.value: A remarkable achievement for open-source animation. Entertaining, polished, and technically impressive.
body.frametrail:name: Overall verdict

frametrail:attributes.text: A remarkable achievement for open-source animation. Entertaining, polished, and technically impressive.

body.value: The opening walk cycle is beautifully weighted — Bunny's mass is communicated through timing.
body.frametrail:name: Walk cycle

frametrail:attributes.text: The opening walk cycle is beautifully weighted — Bunny's mass is communicated through timing.

body.value: Subtle squash and stretch on the flower petals. Blender's lattice deformers at work.
body.frametrail:name: Squash and stretch

frametrail:attributes.text: Subtle squash and stretch on the flower petals. Blender's lattice deformers at work.

body.value: The blend shape system allows nuanced expressions — eyebrows, eyelids, and mouth all independent.
body.frametrail:name: Facial rigging

frametrail:attributes.text: The blend shape system allows nuanced expressions — eyebrows, eyelids, and mouth all independent.

body.value: Ears, tail, and belly jiggle follow through naturally. Great use of soft body simulation.
body.frametrail:name: Secondary motion

frametrail:attributes.text: Ears, tail, and belly jiggle follow through naturally. Great use of soft body simulation.

body.value: Strong silhouettes throughout. You can read every pose even in shadow — animation fundamentals.
body.frametrail:name: Posing principles

frametrail:attributes.text: Strong silhouettes throughout. You can read every pose even in shadow — animation fundamentals.

body.value: The overlapping action on Bunny's ears during the jump is textbook Disney principle.
body.frametrail:name: Overlap and follow-through

frametrail:attributes.text: The overlapping action on Bunny's ears during the jump is textbook Disney principle.

body.value: The trap sequences use exaggerated timing — fast snaps contrasted with slow anticipation holds.
body.frametrail:name: Timing and spacing

frametrail:attributes.text: The trap sequences use exaggerated timing — fast snaps contrasted with slow anticipation holds.

body.value: When Bunny lifts the log, the shift in center of gravity is convincingly animated.
body.frametrail:name: Weight and balance

frametrail:attributes.text: When Bunny lifts the log, the shift in center of gravity is convincingly animated.

body.value: The closing pose communicates satisfaction and triumph. A strong end to the character arc.
body.frametrail:name: Final pose

frametrail:attributes.text: The closing pose communicates satisfaction and triumph. A strong end to the character arc.

body.value: BBB sits in the tradition of Tex Avery's revenge cartoons — the underdog fights back.
body.frametrail:name: Genre context

frametrail:attributes.text: BBB sits in the tradition of Tex Avery's revenge cartoons — the underdog fights back.

body.value: The environmental detail recalls A Bug's Life (1998). Both share the "insect-eye view" aesthetic.
body.frametrail:name: Pixar influence

frametrail:attributes.text: The environmental detail recalls A Bug's Life (1998). Both share the "insect-eye view" aesthetic.

body.value: Like classic Chaplin, the humor is physical and universal — no subtitles needed.
body.frametrail:name: Silent film roots

frametrail:attributes.text: Like classic Chaplin, the humor is physical and universal — no subtitles needed.

body.value: Bunny's design echoes Disney's gentle giants. Compare with Baloo from The Jungle Book.
body.frametrail:name: Disney parallels

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny's design echoes Disney's gentle giants. Compare with Baloo from The Jungle Book.

body.value: The trap sequence is pure Road Runner logic — elaborate setups, instant payoffs.
body.frametrail:name: Looney Tunes DNA

frametrail:attributes.text: The trap sequence is pure Road Runner logic — elaborate setups, instant payoffs.

body.value: BBB proved open-source tools could produce studio-quality results. A watershed moment.
body.frametrail:name: Open movie movement

frametrail:attributes.text: BBB proved open-source tools could produce studio-quality results. A watershed moment.

body.value: The entire three-act structure fits in under 10 minutes. Efficient visual storytelling.
body.frametrail:name: Narrative economy

frametrail:attributes.text: The entire three-act structure fits in under 10 minutes. Efficient visual storytelling.

body.value: Over 100 million views across platforms. Used in countless technical demos and academic papers.
body.frametrail:name: Cultural reception

frametrail:attributes.text: Over 100 million views across platforms. Used in countless technical demos and academic papers.

body.value: Inspired a generation of open-source filmmakers and established a new production model.
body.frametrail:name: Lasting influence

frametrail:attributes.text: Inspired a generation of open-source filmmakers and established a new production model.

body.value: The landscape uses displacement mapping on a subdivided plane — efficient and detailed.
body.frametrail:name: Terrain modeling

frametrail:attributes.text: The landscape uses displacement mapping on a subdivided plane — efficient and detailed.

body.value: Grass and flowers are particle-instanced geometry. Thousands of blades with minimal overhead.
body.frametrail:name: Vegetation system

frametrail:attributes.text: Grass and flowers are particle-instanced geometry. Thousands of blades with minimal overhead.

body.value: Bunny's mesh has clean edge flow around the eyes and mouth — essential for good deformation.
body.frametrail:name: Character topology

frametrail:attributes.text: Bunny's mesh has clean edge flow around the eyes and mouth — essential for good deformation.

body.value: The tree stump uses sculpted detail with normal maps baked from a high-poly source.
body.frametrail:name: Prop design

frametrail:attributes.text: The tree stump uses sculpted detail with normal maps baked from a high-poly source.

body.value: Rocks, logs, and mushrooms are modular pieces, reused and scattered procedurally.
body.frametrail:name: Environment assets

frametrail:attributes.text: Rocks, logs, and mushrooms are modular pieces, reused and scattered procedurally.

body.value: The mechanical traps are rigged with constraints — pivots, levers, and springs modeled accurately.
body.frametrail:name: Trap mechanisms

frametrail:attributes.text: The mechanical traps are rigged with constraints — pivots, levers, and springs modeled accurately.

body.value: Background trees use billboard impostors at distance. Foreground trees are full geometry.
body.frametrail:name: LOD strategy

frametrail:attributes.text: Background trees use billboard impostors at distance. Foreground trees are full geometry.

body.value: Consistent texel density across all assets. The UV layouts are clean and efficient.
body.frametrail:name: UV mapping

frametrail:attributes.text: Consistent texel density across all assets. The UV layouts are clean and efficient.

body.value: The closing shot reuses the opening environment with adjusted lighting — elegant bookend.
body.frametrail:name: Final scene assets

frametrail:attributes.text: The closing shot reuses the opening environment with adjusted lighting — elegant bookend.

body.value: High contrast between character and background makes the action easy to follow at any screen size.
body.frametrail:name: Visual clarity

frametrail:attributes.text: High contrast between character and background makes the action easy to follow at any screen size.

body.value: The color palette works for most color vision deficiencies — Bunny's warm brown against cool greens.
body.frametrail:name: Color accessibility

frametrail:attributes.text: The color palette works for most color vision deficiencies — Bunny's warm brown against cool greens.

body.value: The purely visual storytelling means the film is inherently accessible without audio description.
body.frametrail:name: Audio description

frametrail:attributes.text: The purely visual storytelling means the film is inherently accessible without audio description.

body.value: Scene transitions are gradual, giving viewers time to process. No jarring cuts.
body.frametrail:name: Pacing for comprehension

frametrail:attributes.text: Scene transitions are gradual, giving viewers time to process. No jarring cuts.

body.value: All plot points conveyed through expression and action. Language barrier: zero.
body.frametrail:name: Non-verbal communication

frametrail:attributes.text: All plot points conveyed through expression and action. Language barrier: zero.

body.value: For a transcript, each scene has clear spatial and temporal markers — easy to describe.
body.frametrail:name: Screen reader context

frametrail:attributes.text: For a transcript, each scene has clear spatial and temporal markers — easy to describe.

body.value: The camera is mostly steady. Quick movements are brief and have clear visual anchors.
body.frametrail:name: Motion sensitivity

frametrail:attributes.text: The camera is mostly steady. Quick movements are brief and have clear visual anchors.

body.value: No dialogue means no subtitle synchronization issues. Universal viewing experience.
body.frametrail:name: Subtitle-free design

frametrail:attributes.text: No dialogue means no subtitle synchronization issues. Universal viewing experience.

body.value: Simple plot, clear cause-and-effect. Enjoyable without demanding sustained concentration.
body.frametrail:name: Cognitive load

frametrail:attributes.text: Simple plot, clear cause-and-effect. Enjoyable without demanding sustained concentration.

body.value: Storyboards were drawn in Inkscape and GIMP. The entire pre-production was open-source.
body.frametrail:name: Pre-production

frametrail:attributes.text: Storyboards were drawn in Inkscape and GIMP. The entire pre-production was open-source.

body.value: Made with Blender 2.46. The particle system was overhauled specifically for this film.
body.frametrail:name: Blender version

frametrail:attributes.text: Made with Blender 2.46. The particle system was overhauled specifically for this film.

body.value: Rendered on a 14-node farm at the Blender Institute. Each frame took 5-20 minutes.
body.frametrail:name: Render farm

frametrail:attributes.text: Rendered on a 14-node farm at the Blender Institute. Each frame took 5-20 minutes.

body.value: Blender's built-in compositor handled all post-processing — no external tools needed.
body.frametrail:name: Compositing workflow

frametrail:attributes.text: Blender's built-in compositor handled all post-processing — no external tools needed.

body.value: SVN was used for asset management. The full production files are publicly available.
body.frametrail:name: Version control

frametrail:attributes.text: SVN was used for asset management. The full production files are publicly available.

body.value: Linear workflow with sRGB output. One of the first Blender projects to use proper color management.
body.frametrail:name: Color management

frametrail:attributes.text: Linear workflow with sRGB output. One of the first Blender projects to use proper color management.

body.value: Mastered at 1920x1080 (Full HD) — a high resolution choice for 2008 when 720p was standard.
body.frametrail:name: Output format

frametrail:attributes.text: Mastered at 1920x1080 (Full HD) — a high resolution choice for 2008 when 720p was standard.

body.value: Released simultaneously on DVD, web download, and Bittorrent. Pioneered open distribution.
body.frametrail:name: Distribution

frametrail:attributes.text: Released simultaneously on DVD, web download, and Bittorrent. Pioneered open distribution.

body.value: Seven core artists with occasional community contributions. Small team, big output.
body.frametrail:name: Team structure

frametrail:attributes.text: Seven core artists with occasional community contributions. Small team, big output.
